task_title: fresh npm install on npm>=12 leaves better-sqlite3 without native binding
task_criteria: package.json declares the better-sqlite3 build script trust (allowScripts or equivalent) and documents the manual remedy; a CI step asserts new better-sqlite3(':memory:').prepare('select 1').get() works after install; documented remedy appears in README/CHANGELOG

items.criterion: package.json declares the better-sqlite3 build script trust (allowScripts or equivalent) and documents the manual remedy; a CI step asserts new better-sqlite3(':memory:').prepare('select 1').get() works after install; documented remedy appears in README/CHANGELOG
items.detail: Two of three parts hold, the CI part does not. (a) package.json:34-36 declares "allowScripts": { "better-sqlite3": true } and real npm 12.2.2 honours it: `npm install-scripts ls` reports only "esbuild@0.28.2 (postinstall: node install.js)" as blocked — better-sqlite3 is NOT listed — and `npm install-scripts approve --no-allow-scripts-pin --dry-run better-sqlite3` prints "Nothing to approve; allowScripts unchanged." (control: the same command for esbuild prints "Approved esbuild: added esbuild"). The probe is exactly the required one at scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh:26-45 (`new Database(":memory:").prepare("select 1 as x").get()`), and `npm run check:sqlite-binding` -> "OK: better-sqlite3 native binding loads (SELECT 1 -> {"x":1})", exit 0. (b) Remedy is documented at README.md:39-88 ("Troubleshooting: `better-sqlite3` native binding (npm >= 12)", with npm rebuild / install-scripts approve / --build-from-source / reinstall steps) and CHANGELOG.md:10-27. (c) MISSING: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` has no such step — `grep -n "sqlite-binding\|better-sqlite3\|allowScripts" .github/workflows/ci.yml` returns "NO MATCHES IN CI.YML". Commit 6cb184b4 added the step, then commit e8343f1c ("chore(ci): stage the sqlite-binding CI step instead of pushing it") removed those 11 lines and left them only as an unapplied patch at .coding-hermes/pending/ci-sqlite-binding-step.patch; CHANGELOG.md:14-17 states the step "is staged in .coding-hermes/pending/ci-sqlite-binding-step.patch". No test covers the gate either (`grep -rln "sqlite-binding\|allowScripts\|native binding" tests/` -> empty). Suite run: `npx vitest run --passWithNoTests` -> "Test Files 1 failed | 104 passed | 4 skipped (109)", "Tests 1 failed | 1876 passed | 58 skipped (1935)"; the lone failure tests/mcp.test.ts:184 is a 5000ms timeout that passes in isolation ("Tests 1 passed | 32 skipped", EXIT=0).

items.criterion: The binding gate fails closed: when better-sqlite3 is installed but its native binding cannot load, `npm run check:sqlite-binding` exits non-zero (so a CI step running it turns red), rather than silently passing.
items.detail: scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh:26-45 runs the require + `select 1` probe and exits 3 on a wrong result; on any probe failure it prints the remedy and `return 1`, and --sqlite-binding-only does `check_sqlite_binding; exit $?` (lines 105-108). Proven empirically: with node_modules/better-sqlite3/build/Release/better_sqlite3.node moved aside, `bash scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh --sqlite-binding-only` printed "FAIL: better-sqlite3 is installed but its native binding does not load." plus the npm>=12 remedy and returned RED_EXIT=1; after restoring the file the probe returned {"x":1} again.

items.criterion: The declared trust is actually honoured by the npm in use: with package.json `allowScripts: {"better-sqlite3": true}` present, a fresh install on npm >= 12 produces a loadable binding (no "install scripts blocked" for better-sqlite3).
items.detail: On this box (node v22.22.3 / npm 12.2.2) `npm install-scripts ls` lists only esbuild as blocked, not better-sqlite3, and `npm install-scripts approve --no-allow-scripts-pin --dry-run better-sqlite3` -> "Nothing to approve; allowScripts unchanged." while the same command for esbuild -> "Approved esbuild: added esbuild", showing the entry is parsed and matched. The installed tree loads: `node -e 'new (require("better-sqlite3"))(":memory:").prepare("select 1 as x").get()'` -> PROBE {"x":1}, and `npm run check:sqlite-binding` -> "OK: better-sqlite3 native binding loads (SELECT 1 -> {"x":1})" exit 0.

items.criterion: The postinstall hook runs the same binding gate, so a plain `npm install` (not just the explicit check script) fails loudly when the binding is missing.
items.detail: package.json:31 "postinstall": "bash scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh" and scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh:110-112 `check_sqlite_binding || exit 1` runs the identical gate before the TS-6 setup; the --sqlite-binding-only branch (lines 105-108) is the same function, so the red path demonstrated above (RED_EXIT=1 with the .node file hidden) is the path a plain install takes.
